== Winter solstice ==
* Skype had problems due to playing YouTube videos at the same time
** Have another laptop available at each end? (one for each purpose?)
* Eric should actually organize the Lego before hand like he said he would in his WWW but did not
** It was partially organized but the move necessitated undoing that
* Eric loved seeing the video of the successful climb in Redmond
* Eric wanted to be with the Redmond group
** Maybe he could join us on the west coast next time … although Michelle wants to do a trip in early August, which would use up the Saumurs' travel budget for the year
* Eric: I liked the secondary event we did on Skype to mark the moment of solstice on Monday
* Ben thought that it was really cool to be able to bring together some different types of people who got along well and worked well together.  We ended up with a negative opinion of sci fi fans from our early experiences of going to conventions where no one was interested in SolSeed.  But this time we got some cool sci-fi people and real world engineer people and one person who had a foot in each area. 
* Ben has mixed feelings about holding it in Redmond again.  I would be relieved to have it be someone else’s responsibility but on the other hand I probably can’t invite Redmond scifi bookclub people to Portland (unless they could also include Powells and Voodoo Donuts in the trip). 
* Ben feels like I didn’t communicate everything that I needed to to my guests ... in particular I didn’t mention that the location was up two flights of stairs with no elevator.
